purpose: Keep public names, machine identifiers, paths, and migration aliases stable as AgentOS evolves.

naming_rules.public_names: Use readable Title Case names without project, provider, repository, or transport assumptions.
naming_rules.machine_ids: Use stable uppercase enums for roles and states and compact repository-safe identifiers for questions and objects.
naming_rules.files: Use lowercase kebab case and retain a compatibility alias when a published path has already been consumed.
naming_rules.articles: Use stable numeric identity plus a short semantic slug; never renumber accepted authority.
naming_rules.aliases: Normalize aliases before validation. An alias cannot create a second authority identity or operating model.
naming_rules.project_context: Project names, repositories, providers, deployments, domains, and owner identities are data, never canonical AgentOS names.

BOOTSTRAP.meaning: The read-only discovery, owner-question, exact-plan, approval, and resumable setup controller.

AUTHORITY_CORPUS.meaning: The project-bound source of truth compiled from governance and typed project context.

PROJECT_CONTEXT.meaning: Typed project facts, intent, boundaries, preferences, and external bindings supplied to governance.

CAMPAIGN_ORCHESTRATOR.meaning: Campaign-scoped liveness, custody, dependency, recovery, and closure owner.

FEATURE_AGENT.meaning: Feature-scoped owner that directly supervises feature work and sequentially leased Platform capabilities.

PLATFORM_AGENT.meaning: Campaign-local logical capability with one stable worktree and sequential Feature-Agent supervision leases.

AUDITOR.meaning: Fresh read-only verifier of exact checkpoints and the deployed live identity.

CAMPAIGN_CASCADE.meaning: Adaptive first-pass, applicable audit, Finalizer, delta-repair, and exact acceptance path.

FIRST_PASS_CANDIDATE.meaning: Immutable coherent checkpoint produced before Finalizer custody.

CAMPAIGN_FINALIZER.meaning: Fresh exclusive-writer correction owner for one consolidated causal batch.

NEXT_CAMPAIGN_CANDIDATE.meaning: Content-addressed future-work packet consumed first by one orientation-only next Campaign Orchestrator.

RUNTIME.meaning: Persistent exact integration, deployment, rollback, and live-operation identity.

DELIVERY_POLICY.meaning: Typed project-context contract for source-control, merge, CI-runner, hosting, deployment, rollback, provider, environment, and cost choices.

DELIVERY_PROBE.meaning: Bounded secret-free read-only observation that never performs external delivery side effects.
